scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Toyota 4Runner 3rd Gen?
265/75R16
scenes.body: Toyota-4Runner.org consensus (about 31.6 in); wide aggressive treads or spacers can rub at full compression

scenes.title: 285/75R16
scenes.body: One owner reports no rub on 16x8 wheels with 4.5 in backspacing and about 2 in of front lift (not yet wheeled)

scenes.title: 285/75R16
scenes.body: Common 33-in setup; expect to fold the pinch weld and trim the fender liner, and keep backspacing around 4–4.5 in.

scenes.body: Follow for a new truck every day.
